head: 017b42ad8c944cd0d619b70cddbdf8107a6aabab
detail: Starting from chargeback disabled (details status 'Disabled', single occurrence), opened Manage Budget > Edit Budget, toggled the 'Enable chargeback' switch inside ChargebackSettings, submitted, and the details tab (after reload) shows a single 'Chargeback' status now reading 'Enabled'; the mocked backend project record recorded chargeback_enabled=true from the PATCH sent by the budget modal's save flow.
